title: refactor(rest): move registerBatchEndpoints into batch-routes.ts (#23050 slice 2)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Slice 2 of the `rest-server.ts` split, by slice 1's pattern (landed note `6136102437`, steps 1-6): the body of `RestServer#registerBatchEndpoints` (the cross-object transactional `POST {basePath}/batch` and the per-object `POST /data/:object/batch`, `createMany`, `updateMany`, `deleteMany`) moves, unedited, to the new module `packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts`. It is move-only. Routes, the route ledgers and the published `dist/*.d.ts` are byte-identical, and every reader whose reading included a moved line now reads it where it is. `rest-server.ts` goes from 12,997 to 12,521 lines. The card stays open for the later slices.

## The pattern, applied

**Members the moved body reads**, from an AST walk of the body (base `e611e2bda` line numbers): fields `protocol` :1959, `config` :1960, `routeManager` :1961, `objectQLProvider` :2012. Methods `resolveProtocol` :2339, `enforceAuth` :2407, `enforceApiAccess` :2594, `enforceBatchSize` :2662, `loadObjectItems` :2797, `resolveExecCtx` :2807. That is 10 members. The body has no bare `this` and no element access on `this`.

**Host shape (slice 1's shape B):** the class keeps `private registerBatchEndpoints(basePath)` with its name, docblock and position. Its body is now one `BatchRouteHost` literal and `registerBatchEndpoints.call(host, basePath)`. Each interface member is typed `RestServer['m']`. Methods go as late-bound closures, `(...a) => this.m(...a)`.

**Fields, checked one by one:**

| field | read when | reassigned after registration? | handed over as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | registration only (`crud`, `batch`) | no (constructor only) | value |
| `routeManager` | registration only (every `register` call) | its one swap (`:5670`/`:5674`) wraps `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, not this registrar | value |
| `protocol` | registration only (the four mount conditions) | no (constructor only) | value |
| `objectQLProvider` | **request time** (the cross-object door's `wiredEngineOrLoud(Boolean(this.objectQLProvider), ...)`) | not by the class, but the field is not `readonly` | **getter** |

The getter is measured, not argued. A one-off script boots a source `RestServer` with no provider, calls `POST /api/v1/batch` with `{ operations: [] }`, then assigns `objectQLProvider` on the instance AFTER `registerRoutes()` and calls again:
- this head: `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, then `200 {"results":[]}`. The door reads the live field, as it did when it read `this.objectQLProvider` on the server.
- by-value ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the getter replaced by `objectQLProvider: this.objectQLProvider,`): `501`, then `501` again. The value shape would freeze the field at registration. Restored: blob `bee3d9b7bf56` equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

**Module-level helpers:** `apiAccessDenialFromEnable` was already exported. `wiredEngineOrLoud` gains `export` (one word, same line). The package entry re-exports neither. `ServerScopedDataRequest` is imported from `data-action-routes.ts`, where slice 1 moved it; no type alias is exported from `rest-server.ts`.

## Proof of move-only

- **`.d.ts`**: `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` are byte-identical to base `e611e2bda`, sha256 `7489de84bc6feccb7cb1f28bcbe4a97775324959c61c9bfc35e8a8c45a6f3bc9` for all four files (`cmp` silent), rebuilt at the final head `43903e699` (the merged `origin/main` touched no file in `packages/rest`). The ESM and CJS bundles both load, with 39 exports each and one sorted export-name list (sha256 prefix `84008c9643d55420`); `packages/rest/src/index.ts` is untouched. The bundle JS bytes differ, because code moved within it.
- **Routes** (base `e611e2bda`, head `43903e699`): a source `RestServer` on a recording mock server, with a protocol that implements every member (so all five batch routes mount), dumped under three configs. `getRoutes()` (functions recorded as arity), the ordered server registration calls, and a whitespace-free source hash of every handler are byte-identical base vs head, 9 dumps of 9:
  - default: routes `ee3a764e19bd...ecde0d`, calls `354b948093a5...bc1a6e`, handler sources `d8a6201db1e0...e4c767` (75 routes, 5 batch)
  - scoped-optional: `eb7a21beb5de...56d66a` / `6b60e9f79a6b...c4c0d6` / `38c46865076...6c6c74` (150 routes, 10 batch)
  - scoped-required: `d6d0e5068384...9263e6` / `805edda24595...befc38` / `c077f433ff44...515295` (75 routes, 5 batch)
- **Route ledgers**: `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` and `packages/rest/src/index.ts` are untouched.
- **Moved body**: base `rest-server.ts` lines 12355-12848 (`git show e611e2bda:packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts | sed -n 12355,12848p`), with one 4-space indent level removed (`sed 's/^    //'`), against `batch-routes.ts` lines 90-583: `diff` exits 0 and prints nothing (494 lines).
- **Moved-line accounting** (`git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change f7cd580bf HEAD` over the two files): 501 deleted and 508 added lines are detected as moved. The non-moved hunks:
  - `rest-server.ts` (+26 / -503): the stub body (18 lines); the import of the new module plus its one-line comment; two pointer comments where imports the move left unused were (`omitInternalFieldsFromWriteResponse`; the four bulk request types `BatchDataRequest` / `CreateManyDataRequest` / `UpdateManyDataRequest` / `DeleteManyDataRequest`); the unused `DroppedFieldsEvent` import removed; `export` on `wiredEngineOrLoud`.
  - `batch-routes.ts`: the module docblock, the imports, the `BatchRouteHost` interface and its docblock, and the function docblock and signature.

## Readers re-pointed (sums unchanged, no gate loosened)

- `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` (a gate's target paths; see the note at the end): `batch-routes.ts` is discovered by the `*-routes.ts` convention and declared `dialectOnly` with ratchet #9559, as `data-action-routes.ts` is. `rest-server.ts` stringError 26 to 18 and siblingCode 39 to 31; the new module carries 8 and 8, both measured by the gate. Sums 18 + 13 + 8 = 39 and 31 + 15 + 8 = 54, unchanged. The gate's output differs from base `f7cd580bf` only in those lines and the counts (12 to 13 modules, 3 to 4 ratcheted).
- `packages/rest/src/execctx-consumer-census.test.ts`: reads three files; 62 sites = 48 + 9 + 5, unchanged. Mentions 81 to 85: the four new ones are this slice's seam (forwarder, two; interface member, two). There are now two forwarder frames, and `siteOfStack` steps over both. The control pins one forwarder per moved module (`SITE_FILES.length - 1`), so a module moved without joining the census is red.
- `packages/rest/src/objectql-slot-consumer-census.test.ts`: the batch door, the third consumer, now lives in `batch-routes.ts`. The census reads both files: 3 invocation sites = 2 + 1, all 3 through `wiredEngineOrLoud`, and the batch one is pinned to `batch-routes.ts`. The no-alias check runs over both files. The host interface's `RestServer['objectQLProvider']` is a type that reads nothing, so it is set aside before the check and pinned at exactly one. One new control: one `get objectQLProvider()` in `rest-server.ts` per censused module, so a slot handed to an uncensused module is red.
- `ui-view-route-identity.measurement.test.ts` and `ui-view-route-tenancy.measurement.test.ts`: the whole-file spelling checks count over the three registrar files. `this.enforceAuth(` 48 to 49 and `this.resolveExecCtx(` 63 to 64 (the +1 each is the forwarder), `this.enforceEnvironmentOwnership(` stays 1.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`: the rest-server row's population also reads `batch-routes.ts`, so 70 / 19 / 51 is unchanged; the five moved routes are still RestServer's and still in the blind spot. `this.routeManager.register(` stays 63 (49 + 9 + 5), with a new control for the module's own 5. `enforceAuth` 64 to 68, re-anchored: four seam occurrences, no call site added.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`: the batch-config item's source `rest-server.ts#registerBatchEndpoints (the four per-object gates ...)` now names `batch-routes.ts#registerBatchEndpoints` for the gates, and `rest-server.ts#enforceBatchSize` for the parentheticals that stay in `rest-server.ts` (`enforceBatchSize`, `normalizeConfig`, `parseDeclaredSubConfig`). Both anchors are declarations. `check:platform-checklist` output is identical base vs head.

**Red before the re-points:** the rest suite showed `5 failed` (execctx census x3, slot census x2). The dogfood census with its base text against the moved tree read population 65 against 70, and `this.routeManager.register(` 58 against 63.

**Readers examined and not re-pointed, because the moved lines contribute zero to them** (measured on the moved body):
- `rest-server-query-number-census` (0 coercions), `rest-server-canonical-query-ast` (0 `query:` slots), `meta-draft-read-door-census` (0 draft switches), `rest-server-docblock-position` (0 docblocks moved), the dogfood realtime tripwires (0 mechanics, 0 route hits).
- `auth-gate-allowlist-fault-window`, `execctx-authz-input-seam-reachability`, runtime `meta-list-projection-parity`: they slice other members.
- Gates with output identical base `f7cd580bf` vs head `43903e699`: `check-durability-degradation-log-level`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-single-authz-resolver`, `check-rest-log-declared`, `check:liveness`. Identical except one more scanned file: `check-meta-type-normalized`, `check-nul-bytes`, `check-adr-anchors`, `check-undeclared-dep-imports` (+3 `@objectstack/*` specifiers: the new module's 4 imports less the one `rest-server.ts` dropped).
- The ADR anchor `packages__rest__src__rest-server.ts.json` (ADR-0045, `filterAppForUser`) is unaffected.

## Acceptance notes

- **`packages/spec` readers, not edited (the claim keeps `packages/spec` out):** `packages/spec/liveness/batch_endpoints.json` has five `evidence` strings that name `rest-server.ts#registerBatchEndpoints` and quote a moved line (`const maxBatch = batch.maxBatchSize ?? 200`, and the four `if (... && this.protocol.X)` mount conditions). `crud_endpoints.json` `dataPrefix` names it too, for `dataPath`. `check:liveness` reads them as before and its output is identical base vs head: the symbol anchor is the private method that still registers these routes, and every key-mention (`maxBatchSize`, `enableBatchEndpoint`, `createMany`, `updateMany`, `deleteMany`, `dataPrefix`) still occurs in `rest-server.ts` outside the moved range. The quoted code now lives in `batch-routes.ts`. Named in the report for the `domain:spec` seat.
- `docs/adr/0034-...md` names `rest-server.ts` `registerBatchEndpoints` in a status block. The private method is still the registrar, so the pointer still lands. It is a governed surface and is not edited here.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json` cites `rest-server.ts#deleteMany` for the deleteMany door's parse. That anchor lands on the `deleteMany: boolean` member of `NormalizedRestServerConfig` (`:1244`, outside the moved range), base and head. `batch-routes.ts` declares no `deleteMany`, so a re-point there would not land. Not edited.
- **Coverage of future code, a question for the seat:** the whole-file rule readers above with zero contribution keep reading `rest-server.ts` (plus `data-action-routes.ts` where slice 1 added it). New code written later in `batch-routes.ts` is outside them. Slice 1 set the rule "re-point only readers the moved lines contribute to", and this slice follows it. One shared list of the files RestServer's registrars live in is the long-run shape; it is raised in the report, not done here.
- Lines of `rest-server.ts` between :323 and the moved block shift by -1, and lines after it by -477. No line citation in the repo points into the moved range (base :12351-:12849); the highest is `:11108`, in a release-owned CHANGELOG.
- `ServerScopedDataRequest` stays in `data-action-routes.ts` (slice 1's ruling A: the CRUD slice rehomes it). `batch-routes.ts` imports it type-only from there.

## Gates and tests

All at `43903e699` (the slice plus one merge of `origin/main` `f7cd580bf`, which touched none of these files).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: Test Files 285 passed (285), Tests 5845 passed / 326 skipped (6171), the same as base `e611e2bda`. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test:repo`: Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 213 passed / 2 skipped (215), the same as base. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck`: 0 files / 0 errors).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts test/authz-conformance.test.ts`: 2 files, 108 passed. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Lint: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over `packages/rest`, `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` and the dogfood census: 323 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Every touched lintable file is in the result set. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths: 80 commands. `--ran`: 80 derived, 79 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. 78 exit 0.
  - `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exits 1 with the same 8 findings as base `f7cd580bf` (none in `api-backend.json`); the whole output is identical base vs head.
  - NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3; workspace packages without `dist/` in this container). Stand-in: `packages/rest/dist/index.cjs` and `index.js` both load, 39 exports each. CI runs the gate over a full build.
  - `pnpm check:route-envelope` and `pnpm check:durability-log-level` are both in the derivation and both exit 0.

**Changeset:** none. `@objectstack/rest` ships `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`. Its `dist/index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` are byte-identical, its export list is identical, and its route table is identical under three configs. The bundle JS differs only by where the code sits. `skip-changeset` is the seat's to apply on its own check.
